data.name: Siddharthan
data.gender_notes: Siddharthan is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Siddharthan is recorded with the meaning “Achiever of Goals”. Siddharthan is a Hindu name meaning “Achiever of Goals”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses. Note: this meaning has not been independently verified against a classical lexicon or primary source and is flagged for source verification.
data.spiritual_meaning: Siddharthan expresses “Achiever of Goals”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.

in_sanskrit.name: सिद्धार्थ
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who has attained all his goals, has achieved all that is desired, or one who is perfect in all respects.

in_marathi.name: Siddharthan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Achiever of Goals
in_marathi.long_meaning: Siddharthan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। One who has achieved spiritual and material success.

in_bengali.name: Siddharthan
in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ Achiever of Goals
in_bengali.long_meaning: Siddharthan একটি হিন্দু নাম যা ভারতীয় সংস্কৃতিতে গভীর আধ্যাত্মিক তাৎপর্য রাখে। One who has achieved spiritual and material success.
